scope: Wave 1 current-behavior baseline; no clinical assessment or provider comparison

cases.current_observed_behavior: General health chat uses the standard purpose and returns Markdown text.
cases.desired_requirement: One complete, safe, patient-facing MDQ+ response.

cases.current_observed_behavior: General health chat responds without structured assessment state.
cases.desired_requirement: Preserve current response behavior in Wave 1; future assessment routing is separate.

cases.input: I have had recurring symptoms for several weeks and want to understand what may matter.
cases.current_observed_behavior: One general chat response with bounded recent history.
cases.desired_requirement: Complete response or normalized incomplete-generation failure.

cases.current_observed_behavior: Keyword heuristic selects the heavy model; emergency handling remains prompt based.
cases.desired_requirement: Preserve current routing in Wave 1; deterministic safety comes later.

cases.current_observed_behavior: Temporary authenticated image is fetched for provider analysis.
cases.desired_requirement: Failed fetch is explicit and consumes no successful attachment use.

cases.current_observed_behavior: Validated PDF bytes are sent inline and discarded after the request.
cases.desired_requirement: No text-only fallback or persistence of PDF bytes.

cases.current_observed_behavior: Heavy model returns lab JSON after image quality checks.
cases.desired_requirement: Provider execution is adapter-backed; lab response and record behavior stay intact.

cases.current_observed_behavior: Backend generates a bounded summary before Vault persistence.
cases.desired_requirement: Configured reasoning provider generates the same summary contract; quota errors remain distinct internally.

cases.current_observed_behavior: One replacement generation follows a partial standard response.
cases.desired_requirement: A second incomplete result never reaches the patient or consumes a successful use.

cases.current_observed_behavior: Provider failure surfaces as a safe service error.
cases.desired_requirement: Quota exhaustion and timeout have distinct internal categories; terminal requests release their lease.

cases.current_observed_behavior: Android recorder requests AAC-LC in M4A; backend accepts M4A and WAV only.
cases.desired_requirement: Finalized actual bytes, extension, MIME, and codec agree before transcription.
